title: Analysis code for: Culture-proven neonatal infection: lower total bilirubin and an erythrocyte signature confined to definite pathogens
description:
Analysis code (61 scripts: 54 Python and 7 R, plus the plotting-input CSV files) reproducing every number, table and figure reported in the manuscript. The code covers two neonatal clinical cohorts (MIMIC-IV v1.0 and MIMIC-III v1.4), the measurement-level phototherapy-mediation analysis, the within-subject 48 h/72 h replication of the paired culture-anchored design in MIMIC-IV, human hepatocyte transcriptomes from GEO, and the APR-DRG birth-weight-band coverage sensitivity reported as the last row of Table S2. Mendelian randomisation and colocalisation scripts from earlier versions are retained for audit but are not reported in this version.

No patient-level data are redistributed. MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV are access-controlled on PhysioNet and require credentialed access together with acceptance of the data use agreement; the clinical scripts expect a local PostgreSQL instance holding the MIMIC schemas. All other inputs (GEO) are public.

See 00_Code_Index_and_Run_Order.md for the script-by-script index, the recommended run order, runtime pitfalls, and a table mapping each manuscript number to its source script. The development repository is at https://github.com/ruijin1/IL6_HEPICIDIN.

Version 1.7.3 applies one pathogen-class rule to both cohorts: a culture is coagulase-negative only when every organism reported is a coagulase-negative staphylococcus, so the MIMIC-III stratum estimates change slightly (definite 19 -> 20 pairs, 42 -> 45 admissions).
